description: Name your newsletter in seconds — enter your niche and choose classic, modern, playful, or premium naming styles.

faqs.a: Classic (The X Times), modern (X Brief), playful (The Daily X), and premium (The X Review) — each with its own format bank.
Type your niche (e.g. “AI”) and every name is built around it.
faqs.q: How do I use my niche?

faqs.a: Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Newsletter Name Generator
